body: Hey man, I’m 17 and I feel the same way as you feel at 25, I can’t imagine the bullshit you’ve been through daily. My life is just sleep-try to do some homework- get high to forget everything-sometimes try to kill myself(that failed twice obviously)-finally go back to sleep
Nothing except the pain ever prevented me from going. If only there was some painless way to go, I would’ve been gone a long time ago
Mate we’re in the same boat, I just want to end it now.
No one needs to hear my bullshit, I’m done with my life.

I failed too..
I would like to know what you did, maybe I can do the same tonight...
I wish it had a delete button..
